about: Senior DevOps & Cloud Solutions Engineer with 10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, CI/CD automation, Kubernetes orchestration, and system reliability engineering.
cv_summary:
- Over 10 years of experience in cloud infrastructure and enterprise DevOps engineering.
- Extensive expertise in AWS and GCP cloud platforms, Terraform IaC, and Kubernetes orchestration.
- Strong background in building CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and Jenkins.
- Skilled in monitoring and observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
technical_skills: DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, AWS, GCP, Azure, Terraform, Ansible, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Prometheus, Grafana, Python, Bash, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Linux Administration.
relevant_accomplishments:
• Architected high-availability cloud infrastructure on AWS reducing downtime by 99.99%.
• Automated multi-region Kubernetes deployments cutting deployment times from hours to minutes.
• Implemented FinOps cloud cost optimization strategies reducing annual infrastructure spend by 30%.

work_experiences.title: Lead DevOps & Cloud Engineer
work_experiences.description: Led cloud architecture and automation efforts for enterprise multi-cloud platforms processing over 20M requests daily.
responsibilities: Architected reusable Infrastructure as Code modules using Terraform and Ansible for AWS EKS deployment.
Constructed automated CI/CD pipelines in GitLab CI and GitHub Actions, cutting release deployment cycle times by 65%.
Configured unified observability stacks with Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry across microservices.

work_experiences.title: Senior Infrastructure Specialist
work_experiences.description: Managed cloud migrations, security remediation, and high-availability operations for financial services applications.
responsibilities: Orchestrated the zero-downtime migration of 80+ enterprise applications to AWS cloud infrastructure.
Automated patch management and compliance hardening across 300+ Linux servers using Ansible and Python.
Designed disaster recovery and backup automation routines achieving RTO under 15 minutes.

work_experiences.title: Systems Engineer & DevOps Specialist
work_experiences.description: Provided 3rd-line infrastructure support, virtualization management, and deployment automation.
responsibilities: Managed VMware ESXi virtualization cluster and Docker container environments.
Built automated log aggregation and monitoring dashboards using ELK stack and Nagios.

work_experiences.title: Cloud & Linux Systems Administrator
work_experiences.description: Maintained high-traffic streaming media servers, Linux server clusters, and automated system provisioning routines.
responsibilities: Configured Nginx web servers and HAProxy load balancers handling peak traffic spikes of 50K concurrent streams.
Automated shell scripting and scheduled backups for MySQL database clusters across hybrid cloud environments.

work_experiences.title: Junior Systems & Software Developer
work_experiences.description: Developed backend internal utilities, automated build scripts, and assisted senior administrators with infrastructure tasks.
responsibilities: Wrote Python and shell utilities to streamline software deployment and automated regression tests.
Monitored server health metrics and provided 2nd-level technical escalation support for enterprise clients.

social_skills: Strong leadership, communication skills, collaborative mindset, experience working with international cross-functional teams.
organisational_skills: Excellent project coordination, incident management, agile methodologies, high adaptability under fast-paced environments.
